findings.text: The company was incorporated on 18 September 2017 and its status is recorded as active, with the detail 'active-proposal-to-strike-off'.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for the company.
The accounts are overdue: the next accounts are due 30 June 2026, and the last accounts were made up to 30 September 2024.
The confirmation statement is overdue: it was next due 1 October 2025, and the last one was made up to 17 September 2024.
There are 2 current officers: 1 director, PERSON 331 (appointed 18 September 2017), and 1 other officer.
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 332, an individual holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights, with the right to appoint and remove directors.
PERSON 331 has 2 other appointments, both dissolved companies, and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.
No charges are registered against the company, and no registered office address changes have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 453 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with overdue accounts and an overdue confirmation statement.
